title: Кібератака групи APT28 із застосуванням шкідливої програми CredoMap_v2 (CERT-UA#4622)

entities.name: APT28 (UAC-0028)
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage threat group known as APT28 or Fancy Bear.

entities.name: CredoMap_v2
entities.gloss: An information stealer malware variant that exfiltrates stolen authentication credentials via HTTP POST requests.

entities.name: UkrScanner.rar
entities.gloss: A password-protected RAR archive containing a malicious self-extracting executable.

entities.name: UkrScanner.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious self-extracting archive executable used to drop and execute malware.

entities.name: scan.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable file delivering the CredoMap_v2 credential stealer.

entities.name: SQLite.Interop.dll
entities.gloss: A legitimate SQLite database interop dynamic link library file used alongside the malware.

entities.name: Pipedream
entities.gloss: An integration and workflow automation platform abused for receiving exfiltrated credentials.

entities.name: eo2mxtqmeqzafqi.m.pipedream.net
entities.gloss: A subdomain hosted on Pipedream used by attackers to receive exfiltrated credentials.

entities.name: mariachandran@ginaengg[.]com
entities.gloss: An email address used by attackers to send malicious spear-phishing messages.
An IP address observed sending phishing emails in the campaign.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe whose organizations are targeted in the cyberattack.
